{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= KeyframeAnimation

|descr= Used internally by the [[Arma 3: Key Frame Animation|Key Frame Animation]] system. Called when a button is released.

|s1= [display, button, shift, ctrl, alt] call [[BIS_fnc_3den_onKeyUp]]

|p1= display: [[Display]] - the display

|p2= button: [[Number]] - key code of the pressed button

|p3= shift: [[Boolean]] - SHIFT key

|p4= ctrl: [[Boolean]] - CTRL key

|p5= alt: [[Boolean]] - ALT key

|r1= [[Boolean]] - whether or not to consume the input

|x1= <sqf>findDisplay 313 displayAddEventHandler ["keyUp", {_this call BIS_fnc_3den_onKeyUp}];</sqf>

|seealso= [[Arma 3: Key Frame Animation|Key Frame Animation]]
}}
